notes: Only figures read from a primary official document are listed. This is a BENCHMARK cost (the basis MNRE uses to compute central financial assistance), not a market quote or a price range: real quotes vary. No other cost source was found that is defensible enough to seed.

records.name: MNRE benchmark cost - grid-connected residential rooftop solar (general category States/UTs)
records.source_name: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy (MNRE), Government of India
records.source_document: Guidelines for PM-Surya Ghar: Muft Bijli Yojana - Central Financial Assistance to Residential Consumers
records.source_excerpt: The benchmark cost for 1 kW system is fixed at Rs 50,000/kW for the first 2 kW of RTS capacity and Rs 45,000 for the additional kW with effect from 13th February, 2024.
records.capacity_basis: Per kW: Rs 50,000 for the first 2 kW and Rs 45,000 for each additional kW. The guidelines define central financial assistance only up to 3 kW; for larger systems the same per-kW rates are applied here and flagged as an extension.
records.inclusions: Not stated in the guideline clause.
records.exclusions: Not stated in the guideline clause. Site-specific extra work is invoiced separately by the vendor (guidelines, page 25).
records.gst_treatment: Not stated in the guideline clause; GST is mentioned only for separately invoiced extra work.
records.verification_notes: Read from the text layer of the guidelines PDF (page 8, clause g). The guidelines say the benchmark will be revised at the mid-term review (clause j).

records.name: MNRE benchmark cost - grid-connected residential rooftop solar (special category States/UTs)
records.source_name: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy (MNRE), Government of India
records.source_document: Guidelines for PM-Surya Ghar: Muft Bijli Yojana - Central Financial Assistance to Residential Consumers
records.source_excerpt: The benchmark for special category States (States/UTs of Uttarakhand, Himachal Pradesh, J&K, Ladakh, States in the North East including Sikkim, UTs of A&N and Lakshadweep) will be Rs 55,000 for first 2 kW of RTS capacity and Rs 49,500 for the additional kW of RTS capacity.
records.capacity_basis: Per kW: Rs 55,000 for the first 2 kW and Rs 49,500 for each additional kW (same 3 kW subsidy-cap caveat as the general record).
records.inclusions: Not stated in the guideline clause.
records.exclusions: Not stated in the guideline clause. Site-specific extra work is invoiced separately by the vendor (guidelines, page 25).
records.gst_treatment: Not stated in the guideline clause; GST is mentioned only for separately invoiced extra work.
records.verification_notes: Read from the text layer of the guidelines PDF (page 8, clause g).
